item.title: Mayor, faith leaders unite to tackle safety and youth issues
item.description: Mayor Ramon “RB” Camacho met with local faith leaders—including Bishop Romeo Convocar and representatives from Saipan’s diverse religious organizations—at the Mayor’s Office last week to launch a partnership on public safety, crime prevention, and youth engagement, part of his “Safe Community, Safe Village, and a Clean Island” initiative. (Photo by Bryan Manabat) The post Mayor, faith leaders unite to tackle safety and youth issues appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Grandvrio Resort to close doors after 44 years
item.description: For nearly forty-four years, Grandvrio Hotel Saipan has stood by the people of the Northern Mariana Islands, weathering changes, challenges, and periods of growth. Opened in 1982 as the islands’ tourism industry took off, the hotel quickly became a fixture to both locals and tourists. item.title: Philippine Airlines returns to Saipan with Manila flight in March 2026
item.description: Philippine Airlines (PAL), the flagship carrier of the Philippines, will resume its Manila-Saipan direct flight next year. According to a release published by the leading online platform AeroRoutes, the Philippines’ full-service career will return to Saipan “in Northern summer 2026.” The airline will launch twice-weekly flights starting March 29, 2026, operated by PAL Express Airbus A321 aircraft. item.title: American Samoa Said “No.” The CNMI Must Decide What Future We Are Willingto Accept.
item.description: When American Samoa overwhelmingly rejected deep-sea mining earlier this year, many believed their position would be decisive. item.title: NMI U15 footballers get rousing send-off for EAFF Championship in China
item.description: The spirit of the NMI was on full display Sunday night as the NMI U15 Men’s National Team received best wishes during a send-off ceremony hosted by the Northern Mariana Islands Football Association at the Gilbert C. Ada Gymnasium, ahead of their trip to the FIFA Forward Programme EAFF U15 Championship 2025 in Zhangzhou, China, from December 18 to 22. The event featured opening remarks from NMIFA President Jerry Tan and special remarks by PSS Senior Director for Student Support Services, Jackie Q
